# rig drive: ep1_combat prefix (same anchors) + 124 s of approach-and-attack, so the shipped
# side is forced to land kills: kill counter 0x639bc, quota cells and the fallen states
# 0x5b..0x66 then become observable. Generated from ep1_combat; do not edit the pattern by hand.
# rig drive (docs/310): ep1_kill3's proven start section, then a long walk to each room's exit rect.
# Natural progression only: DAT_6336c is never poked. fn_00012dcc's exit-rect test (0x12e8f-0x12ef0) sets it to 2 when
# the player stands in the room's exit rect (g_dat_5d0a0[0..0x0c]) with a direction key held, and fn_03a829's request-2
# arm (0x3ac2a-0x3ac7b) links to the next room; request 4 (0x3ac80-0x3accd) is the kill-quota arm. Every earlier
# stage-2 route of the rig poked DAT_6336c = 3 (latched entity died), so the arms a real playthrough uses were never
# exercised -- the gap the 2026-11-03 report ('clear stage 1, advance to stage 2: solid black background, crash after a
# while') sits in. Long enough to spend most of its wall time inside stage 2.
